title: G2 · 拒绝
body: matMul is the only task still near 1× on holdout (1.20×) because the bottleneck is memory bandwidth, not FLOPs. I replaced the i-k-j loop with the textbook cache-friendly recipe: transpose `b` into a fresh `Float64Array(n*n)` `bt` (sequential O(n²)), then run an i-j-k triple loop where the innermost k-loop reads both `a[i*n+k]` and `bt[j*n+k]` sequentially, and `c[i*n+j]` accumulates in a register and is written exactly once — eliminating the read-modify-write that bottlenecks i-k-j on n ≈ 64..128. All seven other exports are byte-for-byte identical. Expected: matMul ~1.20× → ~2.4×, geometric mean ~25.3× → ~27.6×, clearing the 26.5× bar with ~1× safety margin.
